subject.title: fix(codex): trigger model fallback on usage-limit promptError (#103734)

question: Should rate/billing profile-rotation recoverability become a shared `AgentHarness` capability, or should Codex encode the non-rotatable limit through narrower attempt-result metadata?
rationale: Either repair changes the plugin-harness contract or its owner-specific result semantics; repository policy requires maintainer confirmation before selecting that compatibility-sensitive API boundary.

options.title: Add a harness capability
options.body: Add an optional typed capability for profile-rotation recoverability and set Codex and Copilot according to their actual account contracts.

options.title: Keep it Codex-owned
options.body: Carry a Codex-owned non-rotatable-limit fact through existing attempt-result metadata without changing policy for other harnesses.

recommendation.title: Add a harness capability
recommendation.body: Add an optional typed capability for profile-rotation recoverability and set Codex and Copilot according to their actual account contracts.
